verdict.rationale: Data export applies to an identity and payments platform, which holds account, agent, wallet, and transaction records. Nothing in the pack documents a bulk export, a transaction-history download, or an exit and data-portability flow. The open KYAPay/JWT token format describes how credentials interoperate, not how users get their data out. Account deactivation is mentioned only to explain how in-flight tokens are handled, not as a documented way to leave with your data.
